title: SmvVerifyAdvancedRequestDto
description: Silent Mobile Verification Advanced request object.

consentGranted.description: Indicates whether you have consent from mobile phone number's owner to perform this request. All requests that do not have this property set to "true" will be rejected.

phoneNumber.description: Mobile phone number (MSISDN) to verify. The number must be in international format.

callbackUrl.description: Your URL that will be called to provide [result](#platform-connectivity/mobile-identity/receive-advanced-silent-mobile-verification-result) when the process is completed.

returnUrl.description: An URL to which the mobile device will be redirected to when verification is complete.

deviceIp.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address of the mobile device that will be verified with operator. Currently, can be used only in Brazil.

devicePort.description: Port of the mobile device that will be verified with operator. Can be used only when "deviceIp" is also provided. Currently, can be used only in Brazil.

c4fb96364cd87b1d1d15720880c5153ef26f5834.description: Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT) specific parameters required for sending SMS to phone numbers registered in India.

principalEntityId.description: Your assigned DLT principal entity ID.

contentTemplateId.description: Registered DLT content template ID which matches message you are sending.

c4fb96364cd87b1d1d15720880c5153ef26f5834.title: DltDto

c4fb96364cd87b1d1d15720880c5153ef26f5834.description: Region specific parameters, often specified by local laws. Use this if country or region that you are sending SMS to requires some extra parameters.
c4fb96364cd87b1d1d15720880c5153ef26f5834.title: RegionalDto

c4fb96364cd87b1d1d15720880c5153ef26f5834.description: SIM swap check parameters. In case this field is null, no SIM swap checks will be done.

period.description: SIM swap check will be verified with MNO in "period" amount of hours from when this request was received. The value should be greater than 0.

proceedOn.description:
If specified, proceed to the SMV verify in case:
- SIM swap check fails
- There is no SIM swap coverage
- Result of the SIM swap check was unknown

c4fb96364cd87b1d1d15720880c5153ef26f5834.title: SimSwapCheckDto

c4fb96364cd87b1d1d15720880c5153ef26f5834.description:
If specified, proceed to the SMV verify in case:
- SIM swap check fails
- There is no SIM swap coverage
- Result of the SIM swap check was unknown
c4fb96364cd87b1d1d15720880c5153ef26f5834.title: SimSwapProceedOnDto

c4fb96364cd87b1d1d15720880c5153ef26f5834.description: SMS failover message contents. In case this field is null, no SMS failover will be done.

validityPeriod.description: The message validity period in seconds. When the period expires, it will not be allowed for the message to be sent.

c4fb96364cd87b1d1d15720880c5153ef26f5834.title: SmsFailoverDto
